title: The six single-lookup e2e scenarios run in two shared clones, keeping their class and test ids
goal: conftest.py: classes named in a SCOPE_GROUPS map share one xdist scope (a pytest_xdist_make_scheduler returning a LoadScopeScheduling subclass that overrides _split_scope, and scope_of using the same map); a test_scope_groups test in test_kb_cohesion.py proves two group classes map to one scope and others do not. test_querylog_e2e.py: a stage world is built once per process; stage A is TestAnswered, TestToolRows, TestRedaction, TestFetches, stage B is TestFixedSince and TestSessions (TestSessions last: it asserts an open session's spool remains); each run reads its own delta (commits after its own 'before', its own Haiku); every assertion stays; ids unchanged; no new dropped ids. If the scheduler override cannot keep the ids, stop and record a gate instead of renaming ids.

run: TestAnswered or TestToolRows or TestRedaction or TestFetches or TestFixedSince or TestSessions
